title: Browser Agent v86 VM profile
description: Schema for source VM profiles in vm/profiles/*.json. Profiles are consumed by scripts/setup/vm-profile-image.mjs to generate public v86 initramfs manifests. Source profiles are intentionally explicit for generated image identity, UI metadata, boot assets, RAM defaults, packages and ordered tool policy.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing to this schema.

id.description: Stable profile identifier. Used as manifest filename, selector value, build id prefix and generated initramfs filename.

name.description: Human-readable profile name shown in the UI.

description.description: Short profile summary shown in the UI and generated manifests.

alpineVersion.description: Exact Alpine minirootfs version used as the rootfs base, for example 3.23.4.

alpineBranch.description: Optional APK/Docker branch override. Defaults from alpineVersion, for example 3.23.4 -> v3.23.

kernelOutput.description: Optional kernel path override. Default derives from alpineVersion, for example 3.23.4 -> v86/images/kernels/alpine-v3.23-vmlinuz-lts.

recommendedRamMb.description: RAM applied automatically when this profile is selected. Profile RAM controls are locked in the UI.

recommendedVramMb.description: Recommended VRAM shown and applied by default in MB. Optional; defaults to 8 when omitted. Use 0 only when the profile has been tested without VGA memory.

defaultDisk.description: Default disk selector value. Use initramfs or one of the hda-* values supported by the UI.

packages.description: Alpine packages installed into the exported rootfs before packing the initramfs. Must include python3 because the guest serial/tool runners depend on it.

allowedTools.description: Ordered LLM tool allowlist for this VM profile. Order is used as default priority when models see a limited number of tools.

extraRepositories.description: Extra APK repositories appended after the main/community repositories.

firstBootCommands.description: Shell commands written to /etc/browser-agent-firstboot.sh and executed during VM boot.

buildCommands.description: Shell commands executed by scripts/setup/vm-alpine-initramfs.sh against /rootfs during image generation.

validationCommands.description: Manual commands printed after build to validate the generated VM profile.

bootMessage.description: Message displayed on serial0 after first boot setup.

notes.description: Maintainer notes for profile-specific package/repository decisions.
